title: OAGRC round declaration
description: Declares a solicitation round BEFORE it is sent: which parties, which prompt, and how each party is to be reached. Frozen once the first capture lands, reusing the bundle-freeze rule that exists because regenerating a round-01 bundle silently invalidated the SHA-256 Gemini's capture record cited. This declares INTENT. What was actually sent is testimony, recorded per-send in the lifecycle log -- the two are deliberately separate artifacts because conflating them records a plan as though it were an observation, which is D-20.

question.description: The round's question in one sentence. Displayed beside the response at capture so the custodian can attest that this response answers THIS question. The prompt-critique near-miss is not mechanically separable from a review -- identical prompt file, identical hash, same round -- so this exists to support a human attestation, not an automated classification.

common_prompt.description: Repo-relative path to the committed prompt. Never composed in the UI.

frozen.description: Set true when the first capture lands. A frozen round refuses edits to parties or prompts.

identity.description: The exact distinct identity string. Selected in the UI, never typed. D-09 -- the record's most serious attribution defect -- is the merging of 'Claude', 'Claude Opus 5', 'Claude Fable 5' and 'Claude Code'; free-text entry is how it recurs through the capture path.

delivery.description: How this party receives the material. Named so per-party asymmetry is visible BEFORE the round is sent: it has gone unrecorded until after the fact twice -- round-01 Gemini got a bundle excluding the transcript, round-02 Gemini got a preamble the other three did not.

prompt_override.description: A party-specific prompt. Supported, and T-14 forbids using it ('Identical prompt to all four'). The UI warns at point of use and names the two prior instances.

allOf.description: A bundle delivery must name its bundle.
